text: Vidyalakshmi PAN India Scholarships. Criteria: (i) The student must be enrolled in a B.Tech / B.E. / B.S. (Biological Sciences) / Dual Degree program. (ii) For scholarship renewal, students are required to maintain a minimum CGPA of 6.5 and above. (iii) The annual parental income of the student should be between Rs. 1 lakh and Rs. 5 lakhs. (iv) The student should belong to the EWS, OBC, or General (GE) category. (v) Female students will be given 50% preference; in the absence of female candidates, a male student may be nominated. (vi) Each selected student will receive a scholarship amount of Rs. 41,667 (vii) The student must not be a recipient of any other scholarship. The last date for applying is November 15, 2026.
